semantic_repair.zh: 只返回 repair_targets 中镜头的修正版，用 repair_of 指向原镜号；拆镜时按剧情顺序重复该 repair_of。其他镜头只供衔接参考，服务器会原样保留。仅在指定镜头内落实检查意见，不得重新生成整章。
semantic_repair.en: Return only corrected shots from repair_targets; set repair_of to the original shot number. Split shots may repeat repair_of in story order. Other shots are read-only and retained by the server. Apply the creative findings only within these shots; do not regenerate the chapter.

review_locations.zh: 检查分镜时，用 shot_sequences 列出该问题实际需要修改的已有镜号。无法定位到已有镜头的全局问题返回 [] 并说明，不要求整章重写。
review_locations.en: For storyboard findings, put the exact existing shot sequence numbers requiring edits in shot_sequences. If an issue cannot be localized to existing shots, return [] and describe it; do not request a full rewrite.

structural_repair.zh: 只返回 pending 中出错镜头的修正版，每条必须用 repair_of 指向原镜号。需要拆镜时，按剧情顺序返回多条 repair_of 相同的镜头。合格镜头已由服务器保留，禁止重复输出、改写或重新编号。修正时间、结构或引用时，完整保留出错镜头的全部台词、说话者和顺序；拆分后每镜时间轴从零开始。
structural_repair.en: Return only corrected shots for pending original shot numbers. Set repair_of on every returned shot. To split one shot, return multiple shots with the same repair_of, in story order. The server retains all accepted shots; do not repeat, renumber or rewrite them. Preserve the failed shot’s complete speech, speakers and order; only fix timing, structure or references. Each split shot starts its timeline at zero.

introduce.zh: 以下人物、物品或场景在全剧首次实际出现时，根据昵称和描述推断并简短介绍一次：{targets}。介绍方式自行决定，不编造，口头提及不算出现；若使用介绍文字，仅该文字例外于无字幕限制，其余遵循原分镜策略。
introduce.en: Introduce these subjects once on their first actual appearance in the entire story, inferring a brief introduction from their nickname and description: {targets}. Choose how to present it; do not invent facts or treat spoken mentions as appearances. Introduction text, if used, is exempt from the no-subtitles rule; otherwise follow the original strategy.
